required_answer_facts: At their next Wake they check victory before flipping Oathkeeper to Usurper, so cannot yet win as Usurper

a new holder receives it Oathkeeper-side. At end of round eight an existing Usurper can win under the ordered endgame rules.

all_104_question_key_audit.asked_clause: List all four Oaths, their matching Visions, and the extra universal requirement for a Visionary win. Do ties for most count for a Vision?
